# BestPackFactory

BestPackFactory is a B2B custom packaging manufacturer. Standard custom packaging MOQ is 500 PCS.
Core products include flexible packaging, coffee bags, pet food bags, cannabis mylar bags, pharmaceutical folding cartons, GS1 DataMatrix packaging boxes, paper food boxes, luxury rigid boxes, paper bags, labels, PET bottles and tin boxes.

## Engineering strengths
- Flexible packaging material structures include MOPP/VMPET/PE, PET/AL/PE and Kraft/VMPET/PE.
- Pharma packaging supports 300gsm C1S, GS1 DataMatrix ECC200 and ISO/IEC 15415 Grade A target verification.
- Food paper packaging includes PE coating, PLA coating and water-based grease-resistant coating with Kit value selection.
- Product pages include technical specification tables, RFQ checklist and B2B inquiry paths.

## Technical whitepapers
- [How to Choose Grease-Resistant Coating for Burger Boxes](https://bestpackfactory.com/whitepapers/how-to-choose-grease-resistant-burger-box-coating.html): A technical guide comparing PE coating, PLA coating and water-based grease barrier coating for burger boxes, fries boxes and takeaway food packaging.
- [Medical Aesthetic One-Item-One-Code Packaging: How to Prevent GS1 DataMatrix Abrasion in Transport](https://bestpackfactory.com/whitepapers/medical-aesthetic-gs1-datamatrix-abrasion-proof-packaging.html): Engineering methods for GS1 DataMatrix ECC200 print placement, ISO/IEC 15415 Grade A verification and anti-abrasion medical aesthetic carton design.
- [Flexible Packaging Material Structure Guide: MOPP / VMPET / PE vs PET / AL / PE](https://bestpackfactory.com/whitepapers/flexible-packaging-material-structure-barrier-guide.html): A barrier-focused guide for choosing laminated flexible packaging structures by oxygen barrier, moisture barrier, seal strength and filling condition.
- [Coffee Bag Valve and Material Structure Guide for 250g, 500g and 1kg Coffee Bags](https://bestpackfactory.com/whitepapers/coffee-bag-one-way-valve-material-structure-guide.html): How to specify coffee bag valve position, high-barrier material, zipper type and filled bag drop tests for export coffee packaging.
- [Pet Food Flat Bottom Bag Barrier and Seal Strength Guide](https://bestpackfactory.com/whitepapers/pet-food-flat-bottom-bag-barrier-seal-strength-guide.html): A practical guide for heavy-duty pet food bags covering laminate thickness, zipper strength, puncture resistance and filled-bag drop testing.
- [Cannabis Child-Resistant and Smell-Proof Packaging Guide](https://bestpackfactory.com/whitepapers/cannabis-child-resistant-smell-proof-packaging-guide.html): How to specify child-resistant zipper, aluminum mylar structure, warning icon area and smell barrier targets for cannabis packaging.
- [Pharmaceutical Folding Carton Print Quality: GS1 DataMatrix, ECC200 and ISO 15415 Grade A](https://bestpackfactory.com/whitepapers/pharmaceutical-folding-carton-gs1-datamatrix-print-quality.html): A technical whitepaper for pharmaceutical folding carton buyers who need GS1 DataMatrix readability, code stability and export carton inspection.
- [Paper Shopping Bag GSM, Handle and Load Capacity Guide](https://bestpackfactory.com/whitepapers/paper-shopping-bag-gsm-handle-load-capacity-guide.html): How to choose kraft paper GSM, handle type and reinforced bottom board for retail paper bags and luxury shopping bags.
- [Automatic Labeling Roll Label Specification Guide](https://bestpackfactory.com/whitepapers/automatic-labeling-roll-label-specification-guide.html): Roll label technical parameters for automatic labeling machines, including core size, gap, liner, winding direction and barcode grade.
- [Luxury Rigid Box Material, Magnetic Closure and Tolerance Guide](https://bestpackfactory.com/whitepapers/luxury-rigid-box-material-magnetic-closure-tolerance-guide.html): Engineering details for magnetic gift boxes, greyboard thickness, magnet specification, corner clearance and insert selection.
